provenance: Selected fields from two production history records, retrieved read-only on 2026-11-15. Bearer tokens, contact details and actor details are omitted. Timestamps are UTC.

interpretation.observed: Token approval history records approved changing from false to true. The later manual approval pre-image has approved=false and retains the same approved token decision identity.
interpretation.inferred: An intervening write reset the approval flag while retaining approval metadata.
unknown: The writer responsible for the intervening write
The exact execution time of that write
Whether a stale Demonstration model was used
interpretation.timestamp_limit: The manual approval pre-image's last_modified is a stored field, not a dedicated audit record of the reset.
interpretation.regression_use: Use the inconsistent pre-image as a regression scenario once the responsible write path is established. These observations do not prove a particular reproduction mechanism.
